seoTitle: How to Edit a Jotform Submission Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to modify existing Jotform submissions in 2026, editing entries directly in Jotform Tables or generating a secure submission edit link.
intro: Correcting a respondent's typo or updating a shipping address shouldn't require a whole new submission, and Jotform offers two ways to edit existing entries. This guide covers editing data directly inside Jotform Tables and generating a secure edit link that reopens the original form pre-filled with the respondent's data.

steps.heading: Open Jotform Tables
steps.body: Go to your active forms dashboard and load the central Jotform Tables workspace for the form you need to edit.

steps.heading: Edit data inline
steps.body: Select a target submission cell and edit text, dropdown values, or field selections directly inside the database grid.

steps.heading: Open the row expand view
steps.body: Use the row expand option to inspect an individual record's full details in one panel.

steps.heading: Generate a submission edit link
steps.body: Click the More Actions menu and select Edit Entry to open a pre-filled version of the live form for that submission.

steps.heading: Save and verify changes
steps.body: Modify the pre-filled fields, submit to save, then check updated status tags and the activity history for that record.

faq.question: Can I edit a submission without opening the original form?
faq.answer: Yes, editing directly inside the Jotform Tables grid lets you update text and field values without reopening the full form.

faq.question: Can respondents edit their own submissions?
faq.answer: Yes, sharing a generated Submission Edit Link with the original respondent lets them update their own entry through a pre-filled version of the form.

faq.question: Is there a record of changes made to a submission?
faq.answer: Yes, you can review historical update timelines and cell revision logs to see what changed and when.

faq.question: Can I get notified whenever a submission is edited?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set up automated edit form notifications through the Settings tab dashboard.
